newsitem.title: USA: Citizens sees Q3 $0.18 per share charge.
newsitem.headline: Citizens sees Q3 $0.18 per share charge.

text.p: Citizens Corp said Friday it expected to take a charge of about $0.18 a share in the third quarter due to about $10 million in pre-tax catastrophe losses from tornadoes and wind storms that struck Michigan during the first week of July.
Citizens, the holding company for Citizens Insurance Company of America, said in a statement it also foresaw a charge of $0.06 a share for Allmerica Financial Corp, its majority parent.
Citizens said it expected gross pre-tax losses of about $15 million from the storms, adding that it had reinsurance for 95 percent of the catastrophe losses above $10 million.
Citizens Insurance Company of America is an underwriter of personal and commercial property and casualty insurance in the U.S. Midwest.
Allmerica Financial is a diversified group of insurance and financial services companies headquartered in Worcester, Massachusetts.
